taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: fronds numerous, clustered, erect, 15-40 cm. long.

traits.height_max_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: fronds 15-40 cm. long.

traits.life_span.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: rhizome stoutish, short-creeping or ascending.

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: a fern.

traits.reproduction.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: sporangia following the short spreading branched veinlets throughout.

traits.rosette.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: fronds numerous, clustered.

traits.perennation.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: rhizome stoutish, short-creeping or ascending.

traits.rhizome_habit.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: rhizome short-creeping or ascending.

traits.leaf_posture.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: fronds erect; the photos show them ascending, the blades tilted out.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: blades deltoid-pentagonal, 6-18 cm. long.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: stipes stout, dark brown, polished, about twice as long as the blades: 8 cm to 25 cm of the 15-40 cm fronds.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: blades 5-16 cm. broad.

traits.leaf_division.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: blades pinnate, or 2-pinnate as to the large spreading basal pinnae.

traits.division_pattern.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: blades pinnate.

traits.division_order.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: 2-pinnate as to the basal pinnae; other pinnae pinnately lobed or incised.

traits.pinnae.note: 4 to 8 pairs of pinnae to a blade, 8 to 16 in all, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 99814168, 104121771, 70040257, 198925083, 11327760, 71102105, 250514270, 214519534): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: blades deltoid-pentagonal, the basal pinnae largest.

traits.stipe_colour.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: stipes dark brown, polished; sRGB by eye from the photos.

traits.stipe_scales.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: stipes naked above the base.

traits.stipe_scale_extent.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma triangularis: stipes naked above the base.

traits.indusium.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 20, Pityrogramma: sori non-indusiate.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: a small tuft of dark polished stalks, each with a triangular, deeply cut, dark green blade, gold-powdered beneath.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for goldback fern from its sources and the photos the traits cite; the rest of its growth comes from the library's rules for the form. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.25 m tall at 4 years in the open, within its sources' range, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
